theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (Fs : ℕ → Set (Euclid (m + 1))), (∀ k, MeasurableSet (Fs k)) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∀ g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) R → (∀ z, ‖g z‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ z in Fs k, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g z : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) ≤ C) → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → ∃ S : Finset ℕ, ∀ k, ∃ i ∈ S, volume (symmDiff (Fs k) (Fs i) ∩ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) R) < ENNReal.ofReal θ
